Bucket List Tracker

Track your bucket list goals with done toggles and an overall progress bar.

0/0
Completed
0%
Progress

📖 How to use

  1. Enter a goal and pick a category.
  2. Click Add Goal.
  3. Toggle Done when you complete a goal — watch the progress bar grow.
  4. Star the goals that matter most.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I use it?

Add a goal with an optional category, then toggle it done when you complete it. The progress bar shows your overall completion %.

How do I star an important goal?

Click the star button on a card. Starred goals are highlighted so your dreams stay visible.

What do the stats show?

The completion percentage across all goals, with counts of completed vs total.

Where is my list stored?

In this browser's localStorage — private to this device.
